# Dr.-Ing. Maram Abu-Muhfouz

> Process Engineer – Research & Development. Materials scientist (Dr.-Ing., RWTH Aachen) based in Düsseldorf, Germany. Research at the Max Planck Institute for Sustainable Materials (formerly Max Planck Institute for Iron Research, MPIE) on β-FeSi₂ thin films for photovoltaics.

## Key facts
- Doctorate: Materials Science, RWTH Aachen University (2020–2025), research at MPIE Düsseldorf
- Dissertation record: https://publications.rwth-aachen.de/record/1019384
- Expertise: thin-film deposition (DC/RF sputtering, PVD), process-parameter optimisation, microstructure–property correlation
- Characterisation: EBSD, XRD, SEM, ECCI, cathodoluminescence, FIB, STEM, atom probe tomography, AFM, STM/STS, Raman, UV-VIS
- Simulation & programming: COMSOL Multiphysics, MATLAB, Python, C++
- M.Sc. Nanoengineering & Nanoscience with distinction (KIT Karlsruhe & JUST); B.Sc. Electrical Power Engineering
- Awards: CTCN MENA Youth Climate Innovation Award, 1st place (2025, 2022); TUM Open Lab Research Award (2018)
- Languages: German C1, English C1, Arabic native
- Open to: process engineering, R&D engineering and materials science roles (coatings, heat treatment, semiconductors, photovoltaics)
